verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser and web-extraction platform for agents, so automatic image captioning is a fair extraction-quality question. However, the evidence only shows URL conversion to HTML, JSON or markdown, with no mention of generating captions or alt-text descriptions for images. Converting a page to markdown is an adjacent feature and does not deliver captions.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
